Very good. Our regular sushi hop-off
Aug 2019
We have been here several times, and live just around the corner so a review is long required.

Roll is located in a cluster of restaurants (most of which have closed down), so it doesn't stand out. There is limited seating, no more than 12 seats so it may be a challenge to find seats at peak hours e.g. 7-9pm of a Friday - Sunday evening.

I guess a review on the food served is more important......yes, the quality of the Sushi served is very good. My fave is the California Temaki, although the Tempura and Fois Gras ones are just as delicious. Miso soup is also excellent. Although they have a whole gang of about 5 cooks milling around, service is a little on the slow side, but then everything is freshly handmade.

Overall, an excellent dining experience.

Hidden gem
Jul 2019 • Family
In Thao Dien Area (district 2) is this must-go sushi bar. 
Take the alley next to Hue corner restaurant, and you’ll find ROLL. An amazing sushibar with a hardworking and professional staff. Using only fresh ingredients and wonderful combinations to prepare one of the the best sushi you’ll ever had.
Try the sashimi combo or foît de gras roll and have a tê tê beer with it. Make a reservation bcause it’s a 9 seater. 
28 Thao Dien. Tel 07 6425 1078

Top-class sushi. Value for money
Dec 2018 • Friends
Small, intimate and beautiful sushi restaurant in 28 Thao Dien which is a new and in food area in district 2. The sushi in Roll is made fresh in front of you and the service is good, smiling and aware of your customer experience. I have been at Roll some few times now and the sushi experience is always amazing. The price is reasonably and the quality reminds me of my sushi experience in Tokyo and Osaka 2017.
